sections.text: Afamitresgene autoleucel is US-approved for adults with unresectable or metastatic synovial sarcoma after chemotherapy who have one of the specified HLA-A*02 alleles and whose tumors express MAGE-A4. SS18::SSX detection alone does not establish cellular-therapy eligibility.

report_comment.text: SS18 encodes a component of the BAF chromatin-remodeling complex. SSX4 encodes a cancer-testis antigen with transcriptional regulatory activity. SS18::SSX4 is a recognized SS18::SSX-family fusion in synovial sarcoma. Afamitresgene autoleucel is US-approved for adults with unresectable or metastatic synovial sarcoma after chemotherapy who have one of the specified HLA-A*02 alleles and whose tumors express MAGE-A4. SS18::SSX detection alone does not establish cellular-therapy eligibility.

evidence_scope: Retained claims carry explicit audit evidence; reference and regulatory evidence is not labeled primary full text.
curation_notes: SSX4 is rare; the mechanistic studies establish the SS18::SSX class, not equivalent outcome data for all partners.
Fusion status alone does not establish eligibility for antigen/HLA-restricted cellular therapy.
